run_reshard_consolidated_checkpoint: run the script to reshard an FSDP-consolidated checkpoint into multiple output shards
run_reshard_unflattened_model_weights: run the function to reshard unflattened model weights into a specified number of shards
run_flatten_tensors: run the helper to flatten a list of PyTorch tensors into a single 1D tensor
run_shard_and_pad_tensor: run the helper to shard a tensor into equal chunks and pad smaller chunks
run_reshard_consolidated_cli: run the CLI tool with fire to reshard a consolidated checkpoint to N shards
